mapper.sql: u.id, u.phone, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.region, u.`identity`, u.crops, u.`status`, u.created_at, u.last_login_at, u.sms_verified_at, (u.recovery_code_hash IS NOT NULL AND u.recovery_code_hash <> '') AS recovery_code_generated, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recognition r WHERE r.user_id = u.id) AS recognition_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_message m JOIN t_ai_session s ON m.session_id = s.id WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND m.`role` = 'user') AS ai_question_count

where.if: (u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT FROM ( SELECT u.id FROM t_user u
ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size} ) p JOIN t_user u ON u.id = p.id ORDER BY u.id DESC
